newsitem.title: USA: Hertz says JP Morgan exercises green shoe.
newsitem.headline: Hertz says JP Morgan exercises green shoe.

text.p: Hertz Corp said on Friday that the lead underwriter of its initial public offering, J.P. Morgan & Co Inc, exercised its greenshoe option to buy shares of the world's largest car rental company.
A "green shoe" is a clause in an underwriting agreement saying that, in the event of exceptional public demand, the issuer will authorize additional shares for distribution by the syndicate.
Hertz filed for an offering of 17.4 million shares of Class A common stock with a "green shoe" over-allotment option of up to an additional 2.61 million shares.

The company said it offered 20.01 million shares in the offering, which is the total of both the number of shares plus the overallotment option. Hertz spokesman Joe Russo confirmed that J.P. Morgan had exercised its green shoe option.
Shares of Hertz were up 3-3/4 to 27-3/4 in early trading on the New York Stock Exchange. The stock was the most heavily traded issue on the NYSE.
